proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ A B X Y _ _ _ _ hX hY
  have hd := EuclideanGeometry.Sphere.isDiameter_ofDiameter A B
  refine EuclideanGeometry.cospherical_iff_exists_sphere.mpr ⟨EuclideanGeometry.Sphere.ofDiameter A B, ?_⟩
  intro p hp
  simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hp
  rcases hp with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
  · exact hd.left_mem
  · exact hd.right_mem
  · exact (EuclideanGeometry.Sphere.angle_eq_pi_div_two_iff_mem_sphere_of_isDiameter hd).mp hX
  · exact (EuclideanGeometry.Sphere.angle_eq_pi_div_two_iff_mem_sphere_of_isDiameter hd).mp hY
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] (A B X Y : P), X ≠ A → X ≠ B → Y ≠ A → Y ≠ B → EuclideanGeometry.angle A X B = Real.pi / 2 → EuclideanGeometry.angle A Y B = Real.pi / 2 → EuclideanGeometry.Cospherical ({A, B, X, Y} : Set P)
